attributes.name: hands_at_face_front
attributes.text: The hands are active in front of the face.
attributes.definition: The main hand activity takes place in front of the face, between chin and forehead, not beside or above the head.

attributes.name: hands_above_head
attributes.text: The hands are active above the head.
attributes.definition: The hand joints are higher than the top of the head during the main phase.

attributes.name: hands_on_head
attributes.text: The hands are active on the top or sides of the head.
attributes.definition: The hands touch the scalp area, from the crown down to the ears or temples, during the main phase.

attributes.name: hands_beside_head_away
attributes.text: A hand is held beside the head but not touching it.
attributes.definition: The hand is at head or shoulder height out to the side or in front of the shoulder, with space between the hand and the head.

attributes.name: hands_in_front_of_chest
attributes.text: The hands are active in front of the chest.
attributes.definition: The main hand activity takes place in front of the chest, roughly between shoulder and lower rib height.

attributes.name: hands_at_waist_front
attributes.text: The hands are active low in front of the body at waist height.
attributes.definition: The hands work at about waist or table height in front of the hips, below the chest.

attributes.name: hands_near_floor
attributes.text: The hands reach down near the floor or feet.
attributes.definition: The hand joints get close to the height of the feet during the main phase.

attributes.name: hands_behind_body
attributes.text: The hands move behind the back.
attributes.definition: One or both hand joints go behind the plane of the torso, at the back, lower back, or behind the shoulder.

attributes.name: hand_at_hip_side
attributes.text: A hand is active at the side of the hip.
attributes.definition: The hand is beside the hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body center.

attributes.name: arm_extended_far_forward
attributes.text: The hand is far out from the body with the arm extended.
attributes.definition: The hand reaches a position well away from the torso, near full arm length, in front or to the side.

attributes.name: hands_cross_body_midline
attributes.text: A hand crosses to the opposite side of the body.
attributes.definition: A hand moves past the body center line to the opposite side, in front of the chest or toward the opposite foot or shoulder.

attributes.name: hand_at_neck
attributes.text: A hand is active at the neck.
attributes.definition: The hand stays near the neck joint, at the front, side, or back.
